evidence.what_it_shows: Rows with Va='SE2R1C' AND Ve='2NTE5F002NL1' exactly (Cn 'BYD SEAL', TAN E13*2018/858*00639*00/*03/*05, Ep 230, Z 166, Zr 570). The IDAE code split at '/' equals EEA Va/Ve character-for-character; the same holds for the Comfort and Excellence codes, confirming IDAE's code format is Va/Ve. This is an exact code correspondence, not a value match.

separate_technical_variants: SE2R1C/4NTE5H004NL1 (Comfort, 170 kW, 61,4 kWh, 460 km) shares Va SE2R1C but is a different version — never merge with Design.
SE2D1C/1NXE5E001NL1 (Excellence AWD, 390 kW, 520 km) — different Va.

TAN revisions *00/*03/*05 of E13*2018/858*00639 carry identical published values for SE2R1C/2NTE5F002NL1; they are extensions of the same approval, not different variants. The 2026 facelift (boot 400→485 L, frunk 53→72 L, 19" wheels, DMS) may be covered by a later extension not yet in EEA data.
EEA 'HAN' rows also show Va SE2D1C/Ve 1NXE5E001NL1 under a different TAN (E9*KS18/858*11304*03, 200 kW) — a data-quality artefact; Va/Ve must always be read together with TAN.
missing_for_upgrade: Already EXACT at Va/Ve level. To pin the TAN revision for the 2026 'renovado' phase: EEA 2026 data (not yet published) or a CoC of a 2026-registered SEAL Design showing TAN extension and Va/Ve; this would also confirm that the facelift kept Ve 2NTE5F002NL1.
